Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

200 W. Paramount Street (V-2024-01)? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a request for a Variance to allow for an increase in wall height from 6 feet to 8 feet on the rear property line at 200 W. Paramount Street located within the Neighborhood General 3 ? Low Density zone designation. The project is Categorically Exempt from CEQA (Class 3).
Item F-1
2.
2024 City of Azusa Development Code Amendments and Amendment to the TOD Specific Plan No. 255 (CA-2024-01, 02) - The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding proposed code amendments to Chapters 88.30.020 (Fences, Walls, Hedges, and Screening), 88.42.190 (Accessory Dwelling Units), and 88.51.050 (Variance and Minor Variance) of the City of Azusa Development Code. Amendments to the Development Code will include the following: updates and clarifications to the fence/wall height requirements, updates to the ADU/JADU requirements, and updates to the minor variance requirements as they relate to fences/walls. Amendments are also proposed to the City of Azusa TOD Specific Plan to allow medical offices (with restrictions) as a permitted use within the Specific Plan area.
